message.content:
The project is complete and verified. Here is the final summary:

---

## Final Summary — Minecraft Go Game

**Location:** `/Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code/tmp/mcgo/`

### Project Structure
```
mcgo/
├── go.mod          # Module mcgo, Ebitengine v2.9.9
├── go.sum
├── main.go         # Game loop, input, block interaction
├── block/
│   └── block.go    # Block types and properties
├── camera/
│   └── camera.go   # Camera utilities (compiles, currently unused)
├── player/
│   ├── player.go         # First-person player, physics, collision
│   └── interaction.go    # DDA ray casting for block interaction
├── render/
│   └── render.go         # Software triangle rasterization with face culling
└── world/
    ├── chunk.go          # Chunk storage
    ├── generator.go      # Perlin noise terrain generation, tree placement
    └── world.go          # World management
```

### Build & Verification
- **`go build ./...`** — ✅ passes (zero errors)
- **`go vet ./...`** — ✅ passes (zero errors)
- Binary produced successfully

### What's Implemented
- **Terrain generation:** Multi-octave Perlin noise produces heightmaps with grass, dirt, stone layers; trees with trunks and leaves; caves/ore holes; bedrock at bottom
- **Player:** First-person movement, gravity, collision detection with blocks
- **Rendering:** Software triangle rasterizer rendering blocks with face culling and ambient lighting
- **Block interaction:** Ray casting (DDA) to place and break blocks
- **Input:** WASD movement, mouse look (captured mode), click to interact
- **Camera controls:** Mouse-based look direction, movement in 3D world

### Remaining Caveats
- The game uses **Ebitengine** which requires a display server (X11/Wayland on Linux, native on macOS/Windows) — it cannot run in an SSH-only terminal without display forwarding
- The rendering is software-based, so performance may be modest on large view distances
- No audio, inventory system (beyond block place/break), crafting, mobs, or multiplayer
- The `camera/camera.go` file compiles but is not yet wired into the main game loop
- The earlier confusion about `/tmp/mcgo/` vs `/Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code/tmp/mcgo/` has been resolved — the workspace-relative path is the canonical one

### How to Play
```bash
cd /Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code/tmp/mcgo
go run .
```
WASD to move, mouse to look, left-click to break blocks, right-click to place, ESC to release cursor.

END_STEP
